column1: # Divergences for Amiga packer wrappers (PowerPacker); see README.md.

column4: RECOIL has no PowerPacker support and rejects the packed file. Unpacked with Ancient 2.x (BSD-2, black box): our depacker output is byte-identical to it, and recoil2png on that unpacked FORM ANIM decodes to the same pixels as ours (pixel-identical, first frame).

RECOIL has no PowerPacker support and rejects the packed file. Unpacked with Ancient 2.x (BSD-2, black box): our depacker output is byte-identical to it. recoil2png on that unpacked HAM8 ILBM (CAMG 0x29824 = PAL monitor, super-hires, interlaced) gives 1280x1024 and our pixels are identical to it. Super-hires pixels are 1/4 lores wide, interlace halves the height, so doubling rows restores square pixels (AmigaOS graphics/view.h SUPERHIRES 0x20, graphics/modeid.h SUPER_KEY 0x8020 on the native monitors). Output reviewed: heart, trash can and cyan lettering on a purple floor.
